purpose: Verify whether earlier unobserved fills can be ignored after later observed close while marking performanceEligible true.

source.independentPositiveControl: Two complete consecutive sessions close cleanly: CLOSED, performanceEligible true, blockedObservations empty.
source.execution: GitHub Actions Node22 dry-run synthetic OHLC. No real D1, broker, order, Cloudflare production or sources accessed.

whyItMatters: A path-dependent BUY_STOP fill or target/stop may have occurred during an UNKNOWN session; later observed close does not prove a unique original entry/exit chronology or realized cost. Although blockedObservations correctly retain DATA_UNKNOWN, final CLOSED and performanceEligible=true can contaminate simulated return, selected->triggered, triggered->profitable and cost/fill denominators.
